newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up slightly vs US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up slightly vs US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan continued its rebound on Thursday to close slightly up at 8.2960 from Wednesday's 8.2962 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai, traders said.
The weighted average price on Wednesday was 8.2959.
The yuan opened higher at an intraday high of 8.2956 and moved steadily between 8.2958 and 8.2960 for most of the session, hitting an intraday low of 8.2963.
Trading was active with most done at about 8.2959, which indicated the yuan got firm support at about the 8.2960 level, traders said.
"Since hitting a two-month closing low on Tuesday, the yuan has bounced up for the past two days and pro-yuan sentiment has strengthened," one dealer said.
He said the yuan was likely to continue to consolidate in the short term if there was no major market-moving news.
Dealers expect the yuan to move around 8.2960 on Friday.
The yuan closed up at 6.7360 from 6.7650 against 100 Japanese yen and slightly up at 1.0710 from 1.0718 against the Hong Kong dollar.
